title: Types
description: The nine types a market's fields are, as a post, a review, a vouch or a report holds their values. An entry holds only whole numbers, so numbers, money and coordinates are decimal text. build/README.md says what a program does with each.

number.description: A number, written as decimal text, such as "3" or "2.5". Filtered by range.

words.description: A list of short words. Filtered by them.

choice.description: One of the values the market lists for the field. Filtered by it.

place.description: Online, or a point rounded to precisionKm kilometres, with the name of its area, online too if it says so, and how far from it the person goes. Searched by how near it is.

lat.description: Latitude in degrees, decimal text from -90 to 90.

lon.description: Longitude in degrees, decimal text from -180 to 180.

precisionKm.description: How many kilometres the point is rounded to.

area.description: The name people know the area by, such as a town or a district.

reachKm.description: How many kilometres from the point the person goes.

money.description: An amount of one currency, and what it is for. Printed and paid.

currency.description: A three-letter currency code, such as USD.

per.description: What the amount is for, such as hour or night. Absent: the whole deal.

moment.description: A time, or a span from one time to another, in RFC 3339 with its zone. Filtered by time.

file.description: One of the files its entry names, by the SHA-256 of its bytes in lowercase hex. The entry lists that file in files, as the standard names a file, so the folder's hosts keep its bytes. Fetched and shown.

hours.description: When a person is free, every week: slots on weekdays, in one time zone. Filtered by day and time.

zone.description: The time zone the times are in, by its name, such as Europe/Madrid.

days.description: The weekdays the slot is on.
